summary:
## Status: complete (pending compile verification, blocked by environment)

All 8 assigned test files are finished, plus 3 adjacent spots the sweep caught (`end_to_end/embeds.rs`, `calendar_head.rs`, `end_to_end/media.rs`, `end_to_end/settings.rs` mode assertions). Worktree-only edits on `agent/trim-obsidian`, no commits, no pushes, sibling lanes untouched.

### Files finished
- **`shell/tests/docks.rs`** — rewrote `tools_move_between_docks` (Recent↔docks round-trip instead of Links/graph-tab; asserts `([Outline,Recent],[Tree],[Recent])` → `([Outline],[Tree,Recent],[])`), rewrote `tools_stacked_folded_and_dragged` (stack Recent+Search; drag Recent/Search between docks; reorder within right dock; restart persistence incl. fold; `show_nav(Outline,true)` alone), rewrote `the_layout_file_old_new_and_odd` with surviving modes only (verified expectations against `Nav::new` parsing semantics). Removed `ToolAsTab` import; `outline_dock…` untouched.
- **`shell/tests/tabs.rs:515`** — dropped `tool_as_tab` call; expected names now `["Alpha","Beta","Gamma","Données"]`.
- **`shell/tests/window.rs`** — keys file now `nav::ShowRecent=secondary-shift-y`; asserts old tags chord is a no-op (mode stays `Tree`) and the custom chord lands on `Recent`.
- **`shell/tests/editing.rs`** — deleted `templates_journey` (461-line fn) + doc-mention.
- **`shell/tests/benches.rs`** — deleted `embed_scale`; startup bench now prints `(images, notes)` and seeds layout `"tree split 260 0"`.
- **`end_to_end/vault_views.rs`** — deleted Tags + Backlinks sections (kept `let was`), deleted Calendar section, dropped vestigial trailing `secondary-t`; doc line updated.
- **`end_to_end/cursors_comments.rs:278`** — deleted 3-line calendar min-width block.
- **`feedback.rs:441-442`** — empty-panel loop now `[Tree, Recent]` only.
- **Caught by sweep:** deleted `end_to_end/embeds.rs` + `mod`/`run` lines, deleted `calendar_head.rs` + `mod` line, `media.rs` graph block → image-tracking asserts (`images.len()` 2→3), `settings.rs` two `Mode::Graph` asserts → `Mode::Tree` (dispatch is now a no-op so Tree holds; `secondary-p` is ShowGraph's new key so `palette.is_none()==true` still holds).

### Verification
- `cargo check --locked --tests`: **cannot complete here** — `gpui@0.2.2` build script fails with `xcrun: error: unable to find utility "metal"`. (Disk space recovered on its own — 23 Gi free — so space is no longer the blocker; the metal toolchain is.) No code I own was deleted outside the worktree.
- `rustfmt --edition 2021 --check` on all 14 touched test files: **parses OK**, no syntax errors (only pre-existing style diffs elsewhere).
- Final grep: zero remaining refs in tests to `Mode::Graph/Tags/Links/Calendar`, `tool_as_tab`, `TemplateAct`, `embeds_shown`, `open_templates/save_as_template`, `s.graph`, `ShowGraph/Tags/Calendar/Links`, `ToolAsTab`, `OpenEmbed`, `NewFromTemplate`, `embed::`/`set_sources`/`first_section`/`embed_points`/`.trail` — and zero in non-test `src/` outside the REPORT list below.

### Updated REPORT list (shared registries — do NOT edit)
- `src/actions.rs` — `ToolAsTab` (:27), `NewFromTemplate` (:44) defs; `views/editor` `OpenEmbed` (:138) def.
- `src/shell/keymap.rs` — bindings/text for `NewFromTemplate`, `editor::OpenEmbed`, `nav::ShowGraph/Tags/Links/Calendar`, `graph::Cycle`, plus help entries.
- `src/views/nav.rs:28-35` — cut action defs kept so the registry compiles; dispatch is a verified no-op (all shell `.on_action` handlers removed).
- `src/views/mod.rs:9` — `graph::Cycle` stub. `src/platform/vault.rs` `template_dir`/`is_template_dir`, all `mcp` `is_template` uses — intentionally kept layers.
- `render.rs:238` `NewFromTemplate` handler (→`new_note_here`) and `settings.rs` `"nav::ShowGraph"` key strings are intentional uses of the kept registry, not dangling refs.

### Open questions
1. Test logic (not just compilation) is unverified — several rewritten assertions (docks round-trips, `nav-row-Alpha` in Recent, `secondary-p` no-op in settings) encode my reading of `put_tool`/`place_tool`/`show_nav` semantics; a real `cargo test` run is needed when a metal-capable toolchain is available.
2. `pane.tool` machinery (`tool_of`, `panels_state` `@tool`, render arm) is now unreachable but retained — confirm whether the integrator wants it removed or kept for old-layout tolerance.
